WITH per_rental AS (
  SELECT
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_sum,
    COUNT(p.amount) AS rental_payment_count
  FROM payment AS p
  JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  WHERE p.amount <= 4.99
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  AVG(rental_payment_sum) AS avg_per_rental_payment_sum,
  AVG(rental_payment_count) AS avg_per_rental_payment_count
FROM per_rental
GROUP BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: Interprets 4.99 as an inclusive maximum payment amount, and treats each rental ID and inventory store ID pair with at least one qualifying payment as a per-rental observation.
